Probably was trying to go over extra cover but got it off the inside half to long-off. Jordan Cox c Lahiru Udara b Tharindu Ratnayake 12(7) [6s-1]

Eshan Malinga to Will Jacks, 1 run, slower full toss, Jacks knocks it wide of mid-on and England cruise to victory with more than 7 overs to spare. The English T20I juggernaut under Harry Brook rolls on, picking up their 22nd win in the last 25 matches

21:26 Local Time, 20:26 GMT, 01:56 IST: Sri Lanka no match for the powerful England unit yet again. Asked to bat first today, they could only muster up a total of 145, nowhere near enough to test the might of the hosts. There were contributions from nearly every batter in the run-chase, with Tom Banton's quickest T20I fifty being the highlight. He was unbeaten at the end and took England home, stretching their winning streak against Sri Lanka to 14 matches. Let's hear from the presentations...

Dawson | POTM: Trying to keep it simple, bowling good lines and lengths (key to success?). The pitch offered a little bit tonight. I'm probably more the defensive option (among the spinners). Jacksy bowls in the powerplay sometimes, I come in the powerplay - very varied. All bases covered which is good. You come here knowing it's a big square. I actually don't mind bowling into the wicket. It's not too bad. Decent wicket. Good to get the win. No, not really (change of plans for Manchester?). Keep bowling how I do - defensively to get wickets. Hopefully do that and do well.

Asalanka | SL captain: Disappointed about the performance. When we were starting, in the powerplay, we were in the game. We scored close to 60-odd runs. Then we gave wickets at regular intervals, that was disappointing. We just didn't play good cricket and good shots. That is the key. At the same time, they were too good. Going forward, we have to improve a lot. We're not upto the mark. That's why we are in number 9 position.

The series is sealed 2-0, and the teams head off to Manchester for the final T20I that will take place on Saturday. Will take something special for Sri Lanka to challenge this England side, which they haven't been able to do so far. That's all for now. Until next time, it's goodbye!
